2	
3	## Overview
4	This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.
5	
6	## Data Source
7	
8	### tariff_rates
9	Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.
10	
11	### bilateral_trade
12	Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).
13	
14	### supply_chain_share
15	Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.
16	
17	### policy_events
18	Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.
19	
20	## Data Notes
21	- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
22	- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
23	- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
24	- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

# ── Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tariff_periods = [
    "2017-H1","2017-H2","2018-H1","2018-H2",
    "2019-H1","2019-H2","2020-H1","2020-H2",
    "2021-H1","2021-H2","2022-H1","2022-H2",
    "2023-H1","2023-H2","2024-H1"
]
us_tariff   = [3.1,3.1,3.8,12.0,18.3,21.0,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,19.3,25.4]
china_tariff= [8.0,8.0,8.0,16.5,20.7,21.8,20.9,20.9,20.9,20.9,21.1,21.1,21.2,21.2,23.1]

# Half-year numeric axis (2017.0, 2017.5, 2018.0 …)
def period_to_x(p):
    y, h = p.split("-")
    return int(y) + (0.0 if h == "H1" else 0.5)

tx = [period_to_x(p) for p in tariff_periods]

# Trade volumes
years        = [2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024]
exports      = [115.6,129.9,120.3,106.4,124.5,151.1,153.8,147.8,138.2]
imports_cn   = [462.6,505.5,539.5,452.2,435.4,506.4,536.8,427.2,401.5]
total_trade  = [578.2,635.4,659.8,558.6,559.9,657.5,690.6,575.0,539.7]

# Supply chain shares
sc_china   = [21.4,21.6,21.2,18.1,18.6,17.9,16.5,13.9,12.8]
sc_vietnam = [2.1,2.2,2.6,2.9,3.4,3.7,3.9,4.5,4.9]
sc_india   = [2.1,2.2,2.3,2.4,2.3,2.7,2.8,3.1,3.4]

# Policy events (x-position, label, category)
policy_events = [
    (2017.5, "§301\nInvestigation",  "investigation"),
    (2018.0, "§301 Memo\n$50B tariffs","tariff"),
    (2018.5, "Lists 1–3\nimposed",    "tariff"),
    (2019.0, "List 3\nraised 25%",    "tariff"),
    (2019.5, "List 4A\n15%",          "tariff"),
    (2020.0, "Phase One\nDeal",        "deal"),
    (2021.5, "USTR Tai\nReview",       "review"),
    (2022.0, "Biden\nExclusions",      "review"),
    (2024.0, "Biden raises\nEV/Semi tariffs","tariff"),
]

cat_color = {"investigation":"#9b59b6","tariff":"#c0392b","deal":"#27ae60","review":"#f39c12"}

# ── Style ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG       = "#0f1117"
PANEL_BG = "#161b22"
GRID_CLR = "#2a2f3a"
TEXT_CLR = "#e6edf3"
SUBTEXT  = "#8b949e"
US_CLR   = "#4fa3e8"
CN_CLR   = "#e05c5c"
VN_CLR   = "#f0a843"
IN_CLR   = "#5ccb8e"
TOTAL_CLR= "#a78bfa"

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family":    "DejaVu Sans",
    "text.color":     TEXT_CLR,
    "axes.labelcolor":TEXT_CLR,
    "xtick.color":    SUBTEXT,
    "ytick.color":    SUBTEXT,
    "axes.edgecolor": GRID_CLR,
    "axes.facecolor": PANEL_BG,
    "figure.facecolor":BG,
    "grid.color":     GRID_CLR,
    "grid.linewidth": 0.5,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 14))
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    3, 1,
    figure=fig,
    hspace=0.55,
    left=0.07, right=0.97,
    top=0.91, bottom=0.06
)

# ── Panel 1: Tariff Escalation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax1.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)

ax1.step(tx, us_tariff,    where="post", color=US_CLR, lw=2.5, label="US tariffs on Chinese imports", zorder=3)
ax1.step(tx, china_tariff, where="post", color=CN_CLR, lw=2.5, label="China tariffs on US imports",   zorder=3)
ax1.fill_between(tx, us_tariff,    step="post", alpha=0.15, color=US_CLR)
ax1.fill_between(tx, china_tariff, step="post", alpha=0.15, color=CN_CLR)

ax1.set_xlim(2016.8, 2024.6)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 30)
ax1.set_ylabel("Tariff Rate (%)", fontsize=10, labelpad=8)
ax1.set_xticks([2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024])
ax1.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in [2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024]], fontsize=9)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FormatStrFormatter('%d%%'))
ax1.grid(True, axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=9, framealpha=0.2, labelcolor=TEXT_CLR,

# Policy event annotations on top panel

        xy=(xpos, anny),
        fontsize=6.5,
        color=clr,
        ha="center", va="bottom",
        fontweight="bold",
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc=BG, ec=clr, alpha=0.7, lw=0.8),
    )

ax1.set_title("US–China Tariff Escalation with Policy Milestones",
              fontsize=12, color=TEXT_CLR, loc="left", pad=10, fontweight="bold")

patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=v, label=k.capitalize()) for k,v in cat_color.items()]
ax1.legend(
    handles=patches,
    loc="lower right", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.25,
    facecolor=PANEL_BG, edgecolor=GRID_CLR,

l2 = ax1.plot([], [], color=CN_CLR, lw=2.5, label="China tariffs on US goods")[0]
first_legend = ax1.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc="upper left", fontsize=9,

ax1.add_artist(first_legend)
ev_legend = ax1.legend(handles=patches, loc="lower right", fontsize=8,
                        framealpha=0.25, facecolor=PANEL_BG, edgecolor=GRID_CLR,
                        title="Event type", title_fontsize=8)

# ── Panel 2: Bilateral Trade Volume ──────────────────────────────────────────
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax2.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)

bar_w = 0.28
xb = np.array(years)
bars_exp = ax2.bar(xb - bar_w/2, exports,    width=bar_w, color=US_CLR, alpha=0.85,
                   label="US Exports to China", zorder=3)
bars_imp = ax2.bar(xb + bar_w/2, imports_cn, width=bar_w, color=CN_CLR, alpha=0.85,
                   label="US Imports from China", zorder=3)

ax2_twin = ax2.twinx()
